item.title: Shaping the Future
item.content:encoded:
Diego Matricano, University of Campania "Luigi Vanvitelli"

This multi-journal collection brings together cross-disciplinary research on entrepreneurship and its role in shaping the future. It welcomes contributions from researchers, practitioners, and policymakers who examine entrepreneurship as a means to tackle significant global challenges and understand how entrepreneurial activities create expected and realized changes across different contexts.

Papers in this collection analyze entrepreneurship at multiple levels of analysis—from individual and organizational (micro) to industry and regional (meso) to national and global (macro)—to explore how entrepreneurship can drive positive transformation and address contemporary issues.

Appel publié par International Entrepreneurship and Management Journal. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Entrepreneurship as a mechanism for addressing global issues
  • Impact of entrepreneurship on future development
  • Micro, meso, and macro levels of entrepreneurial analysis
  • Expected and realized changes in entrepreneurship phenomena
  • Implications of entrepreneurship for society and economy
